title: Glencree reformatory
html_source:
In the 1850s, after the Great Irish Famine, the building (Glencree Barracks) was re-opened as “St Kevin’s Reformatory'” and it was run by the Oblates of Mary Immaculate. Young boys were sent here instead of prison for petty crimes. It was closed in 1940
http://www.wicklowway.com/towns-villages/glencree.php

It is now a centre for peace.
